commentary.text: 90+5' Michael Salisbury is looking at his watch and immediately ends this match.
90+5' Nottingham failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.

90+3' 2 - 4 Dara O'Shea showcases his great technique and produces a beautiful lofted cross into the box. George Hirst (Ipswich) meets the cross and gets himself onto the scoresheet with a header into the bottom left corner. It's 2:4.
90+1' Neco Williams (Nottingham) sends a chip pass into the box, but Alex Palmer is quickest to intercept the ball.

86' Here comes a substitution. Jack Taylor (Ipswich) is brought on as a substitute for Kalvin Phillips.
85' Alex Palmer displays his ability to read the game and clears the danger after Jota Silva (Nottingham) threatened to latch onto a through ball from just outside the box.
